detail.title: Investigating Predictive Processing and Musical Valence
detail.summary: We are continuing our research into the emotional valence of music by investigating the intersection of predictive coding mechanisms and biological reward systems. While our current notebook establishes a link between predictive error-correction and general musical engagement, we need to specifically bridge the gap to understand how these processes trigger the emotional valence (pleasure/reward) associated with musical tension and resolution. This research will search for literature connecting predictive coding in musical cognition with dopaminergic reward pathways.
